research_period.rule: Use only the intersection supported by qualified point-in-time membership, total-return, Treasury, and historical-session evidence; do not shorten the period after observing results. If that intersection is empty or methodologically inadequate, classify the affected tests INCONCLUSIVE.

temporal_convention.decision: after all required month-end evidence is available
temporal_convention.effective: next eligible U.S. equity trading session after decision
temporal_convention.return_accounting: close-to-close total return from one effective rebalance session to the next; no same-close execution

evidence_contract.sector_universe: authoritative point-in-time U.S. Select Sector ETF membership with instrument inception boundaries
evidence_contract.risky_and_spy_returns: canonical split-and-dividend-adjusted or authoritative total-return evidence; raw and split-only closes prohibited
evidence_contract.defensive_return: canonical research_asset:us_3_month_treasury_total_return; ETF, cash, and raw-yield proxies prohibited
evidence_contract.calendar: qualified historical U.S. equity sessions including exceptional closures
evidence_contract.missing_policy: required unknown evidence makes the affected decision or experiment unavailable; no imputation

benchmarks.B2: monthly equal-weight among all eligible sector ETFs
benchmarks.B3: monthly top-three trailing-12-month sector momentum without a trend gate, equal one-third sleeves
benchmarks.B4: monthly equal-weight sleeves across all eligible sectors; each sector whose completed-month observation is not strictly above its 10-month completed-month SMA sends only its own sleeve to the canonical defensive asset

accounting.weights: target weights apply at the effective rebalance session
accounting.turnover: one-half of the sum of absolute target-weight changes at each rebalance
accounting.transaction_cost: 10 basis points per one-way unit of turnover, deducted at rebalance
accounting.dividends: included only through qualified total-return evidence

metrics.cagr: annualized geometric return when the qualified period is at least 12 months
metrics.annualized_volatility: sample standard deviation of monthly returns times sqrt(12)
metrics.annualized_return_to_volatility: arithmetic mean monthly return times 12 divided by annualized volatility; undefined when volatility is zero
metrics.defensive_allocation_frequency: fraction of rebalance decisions with nonzero defensive target weight

H1.predicate: S1 net CAGR > B0 net CAGR
H1.interpretation: The frozen risky/defensive policy outgrows the defensive baseline in the qualified test.

H2.predicate: S1 net annualized_return_to_volatility > B1 net annualized_return_to_volatility
H2.interpretation: S1 improves return per unit of realized volatility versus SPY in the qualified test.

H3.predicate: abs(S1 net maximum_drawdown) < abs(B1 net maximum_drawdown)
H3.interpretation: S1 reduces maximum drawdown magnitude versus SPY in the qualified test.

H4.predicate: S1 net annualized_return_to_volatility > B3 net annualized_return_to_volatility AND abs(S1 net maximum_drawdown) <= abs(B3 net maximum_drawdown)
H4.interpretation: The frozen trend gate improves risk-adjusted behavior without worsening drawdown versus momentum alone.

H5.predicate: In preregistered walk-forward test windows, S1 median net 12-month excess return over B1 > 0 AND S1 pooled OOS net annualized_return_to_volatility > 0
H5.interpretation: S1's out-of-sample behavior is directionally persistent rather than confined to the full-sample aggregate.

assessment.SUPPORTED_IN_TEST: all predicate clauses are true on qualified evidence
assessment.NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_TEST: at least one predicate clause is false on qualified evidence
assessment.INCONCLUSIVE: the required qualified evidence or mathematically defined metric is unavailable

robustness_grid.rule: One-factor-at-a-time variations around S1 only; S1 remains 12/10/3 and is never replaced or re-tuned from results.

walk_forward.first_window: first complete 12-month window after all S1 lookbacks and qualified evidence are available
walk_forward.aggregation: preserve each window identity and additionally report pooled OOS return series

anti_bias.amendment_rule: Never mutate this artifact after result-bearing output exists; create a new version retaining this original.
anti_bias.data_limited_rule: Do not execute result-bearing experiments until a new immutable evidence qualification authorizes them.
anti_bias.negative_result_rule: A valid negative result remains a research result and does not authorize changing production S001.
